note: Strong branded vehicle and two personnel. Crop competing banners and keep the full vehicle identity. Good hero candidate after restrained reframing.
Two control-room operators, phone and workstation: shows the service behind the alarm. Strong replacement for a generic monitoring illustration. Inspect screens and desk papers before publishing.
Active vehicle check with a recognisable entrance. Stronger service narrative than another static line-up. Crop road/sky, preserve guard and inspection mirror.
Guard framed by the building entrance. Balanced architectural setting; useful hero or section image. Retain door frame as context.
Technician working on an actual camera, with strong equipment detail. Crop around face, hands and camera; extend sky sideways only if required for title space.
Supervisor briefing a team: clear evidence of operational preparation. Keep supervisor, notes and responding guards in frame.
Actual event-related setting with Winstar branding, but guard faces away and file is only 1024px wide. Supporting image or uniform reference; not first-choice desktop hero.
Dog actively checking a vehicle with handler. Better service story than a posed dog. Preserve leash, handler hands and vehicle opening; extend surrounding greenery if needed.
Courteous visitor interaction at reception. Strong guest-assistance image; not evidence of biometric equipment or airport screening.
Two reception personnel in a bright architectural setting, friendly expressions and visible uniforms. Strong people-focused supporting photograph.
Fleet overview with branded vehicles. Useful proof of operational resources. Wide hero crop can work if vehicle names and personnel remain readable.
Two control-room personnel with reporting materials. Good management/support image; more posed than the working control-room sequence.
Two response personnel, dog and branded vehicle. Strong team/capacity context; use beside deployment support rather than claiming detection in progress.
Branded vehicle with two personnel and clear exterior setting. Suitable generic escort-support hero; does not demonstrate a VIP or cargo assignment itself.
Officer stepping from response vehicle: clear action, stronger than leaning/posing. Crop carefully to retain head, handhold and vehicle door.
Technician working above a wall. Visible wire appears to include razor wire; inspect before labelling this an electric-fence installation. Good perimeter-work supporting image.
Personnel handling a ladder with PPE. Useful engineering/installation support, but no visible installed product to identify a specific service.
Guard assisting a wheelchair user. Strong service and accessibility story. Supporting image, retain the actual assistance interaction.
Close radio-use image in vehicle. Good inset for control-room/field communication; portrait composition less suited to wide hero.
Wide team line-up. Good alternative to expanding the old close portrait; less explanatory than briefing or visitor-assistance shots.
